title: Ravish
problem: Text: "it deals damage to the enemy". The code hits whoever dealt the damage, with no side check. So a hit from an ally (a Confused attack, or a Stand As One copy, which is sourced to the damaged ally) makes Ravish hit that ally, and a hit sourced to the holder itself bounces back onto itself. Two holders on opposite sides do bounce hits back and forth until the per-turn damage limit (15) stops it, which is what the text literally says.
notes: Text: After this creature takes damage, it deals damage to the enemy equal to 100% of the damage taken. Evidence: bc_EventDamage L7050: source > -1 @0x140f70820, scr_CritHasPassive(creature, 1100) @0x140f70a0e, amount > 0 @0x140f70a57; no slot comparison. L7051: bc_EventDamage(creature as source, source as target, amount) @0x140f71240, queued scr_AddEventToStack @0x140f712cf. Precedent: SU-0126 Spiderlings (same missing enemy test, patched). Fix sketch: Call-site hook on scr_CritHasPassive(creature, 1100) at bc_EventDamage L7050 (call @0x140f70a0e, same pattern as the SU-0124 / SU-0126 hooks): return false unless the damaged creature and the source are on opposite sides ((creature.slot == 0) != (source.slot == 0); slot var 0x1499e0aa8, source var 0x1499e0c38, creature var 0x1499e3228). The source > -1 test runs before it, so the source is valid. Reasoning: "The enemy" names the target as an enemy; the code never checks the side. Same shape as Spiderlings (SU-0126), which the text-is-the-contract ruling already fixed with a side test. The timing and Barrier points are game-wide conventions the text does not address. App note (unpatched game): In the unpatched game Ravish hits whoever dealt the damage, allies included (e.g. a Confused ally); it uses the damage before Barrier, and dodged or prevented hits do not trigger it. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patched (batch I, 2026-10-26): call-site hook on the L7050 scr_CritHasPassive(creature, 1100) gate (0x140f70a0e) -> hook_i_su0297_ravish (loader/hooks_I.c): false when the event's source and creature are on the same side (slot == 0 vs > 0); unknown sides keep the game's answer. Source > -1 is tested before the gate.

release_notes.intended: After this creature takes damage, it deals damage to the enemy equal to 100% of the damage taken.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Ravish hit back whoever dealt the damage, with no side check. A hit from a Confused ally (or a copied hit credited to an ally) made it damage that ally, and damage credited to the creature itself bounced back onto itself.
release_notes.fix: Now Ravish only hits back when the damage came from an enemy.
